property_summary: After any setL1BlockValues call by the depositor, c.basefee() must equal the _basefee argument; the mutant stores _l1FeeScalar there instead, which differs whenever _basefee != _l1FeeScalar.
change_summary: Replace `basefee = _basefee;` with `basefee = _l1FeeScalar;` so basefee receives the wrong value.
